gate.no_kill_switch: no threshold; the fitted gamma is the reported design rule. Monotonicity of beta with width is checked and reported (if beta is not monotone in width, the 'data-elastic compute' rule is only a 2-3 point trend, not a law).

method.disclosure: only 3 n-points per atom count -> the per-atoms exponent fits are rough (2-parameter fits on 3 points); the regression over 3 widths is likewise a disclosure-level estimate, reported with the raw steepnesses (which M117 already recorded). This is a quantification of an already-sealed effect, not a new experiment.
method.per_atoms_exponent: for each atom count, fit the n-axis gain: gain(n) = acc(n) - acc(n_min); fit log(gain) vs log(n) by least squares -> exponent beta (the Q(n) power), on the points where gain > 0
method.width_regression: head width W = 4 * atoms (pool_grid^2 * atoms); regress log(beta) vs log(W) -> gamma, the data-elasticity exponent: beta ~ W^gamma
